posts.body:
A small workflow Pocket Dev supports: checking a terminal from your phone while the command runs on your computer.

Open the computer’s terminal in your phone’s browser, check the output, and send another command when needed.

Pocket Dev also brings coding-agent chats, Git and files into the same browser interface. We built it to make those short check-ins easier when you step away from your desk.

The clip shows demo data. Same Wi-Fi works by default; away-from-home access needs optional setup. Your computer must stay on and awake.

Try it: https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev
Source: https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev

Which terminal task would you want to check without returning to your desk?

#PocketDev #DeveloperTools #OpenSource

posts.body:
Want to try Pocket Dev? Start with the setup guide, or give the setup prompt to your coding assistant.

1. Open the guide on the computer you want to access.
2. Follow the installation and first-run steps.
3. Connect your phone on the same Wi-Fi and open the interface in its browser.

There’s no phone app or Pocket Dev cloud account to create. Claude Code and Codex use your existing accounts. Your computer needs to stay on and awake; remote access away from home needs extra setup.

We’ve put the setup instructions and copyable AI prompts here:

Guide: https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev/docs/setup
AI setup prompt: https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev/prompts
npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anisirji/pocket-dev

The screenshot shows demo data. What part of setup would you like us to explain more clearly?

#PocketDev #OpenSource #DeveloperTools
